title: RAW: immutable base procedures, explicit modifications and separately recorded trial outcomes
summary: User-requested combination2+7: a procedure family transmits an explicit baseline reference, typed modifications, applicability and an independent outcome. Full reconstruction distinguishes each baseline variant from a chain inheriting the previous trial. No native word values or glyph code.

design.purpose: Record related practical trials without rewriting the complete common procedure. The reader must already possess the actual baseline, not merely a title.

message_domain.baseline_library: Finite versioned exact procedure graphs: objects, ordered actions, quantities/conditions and references. All baseline contents and primitive operations are paid stored information.
message_domain.entry: (record_id, mode, base_reference, explicit_changes, applicability, outcome_or_NOT_RECORDED). Modes distinguish intended procedure, performed trial and reported result.
message_domain.change: Typed replacement of a named argument/parameter/action, insertion or deletion at an unambiguous named location. No implicit per-entry reinterpretation.
message_domain.defaults: Omitted fields inherit ONLY from the explicit base_reference. No nearest-record inheritance or picture-selected base unless a separate fixed rule is specified.
message_domain.reconstruction: Copy named immutable base, apply written changes in their stated scope, retain applicability and separately supplied actual outcome. Never calculate an observed result from an intended recipe.
message_domain.order: If changes act on the same field, order must be written or the entry is rejected as ambiguous. Repeated instructions remain written occurrences; no deletion of awkward repeats.

worked_source_only_example.base: B0: prepare object A; place A in vessel V; wait interval T; remove A from V.
worked_source_only_example.entry1: BASE B0; replace V by W; observation R1 explicitly supplied. Reconstructed recipient vessel W, interval T.
worked_source_only_example.entry2_independent: BASE B0; replace T by 2T; observation R2 explicitly supplied. Reconstructed vessel V, interval2T.
worked_source_only_example.entry2_chained_rival: BASE entry1; replace T by2T. Reconstructed vessel W, interval2T. This differs from the independent variant, even though the local change text is identical.
worked_source_only_example.limits: Synthetic logical demonstration only, not historical recipe, natural-language source, Voynich transcription or translation. R1/R2 are supplied observations, not success claims.

design.unequal_written_prediction: Independent variants and a serial trial notebook disagree on the inherited vessel in entry2. A full target reading must determine the base and the unchanged arguments, and a later written or independently pictured consequence must distinguish the two. Merely counting similar paragraphs cannot do so.
design.manuscript_first_application: Use the existing complete f83r packet as a common comparison context with image-argument and curriculum contracts. Three upper local scenes versus one lower coupled scene do not identify a common baseline or demonstrate that an experiment took place. All seven records and four captions remain obligations.
old_decisions_retained: W89 recipe pause; no comparative victory from unequal completeness requirements.

IDEA920 recipient nominal/clause attempt remains nonconfirming; its Adri anum source shows a shared preparation with conditional administration, not evidence for experimental outcomes or our baseline pointer.
GDT1129 symbolic complete accounts without bound world truth remain nontranslating; grammar and reconstruction alone do not select semantics.
No first/last-letter, source-word delta, binary rank or compulsory disjoint-field repair is made.
assumptions_and_missing: Actual baseline library, primitive meanings and version references are unbound.
Physical encoding into the22working signs is unspecified; no statistical match claimed.
Participant/reference scope, measured outcome and written change grouping require evidence.
No meaning of any native whole or substring adopted.

decision_note.question: Can the three user-selected big models be made explicit enough to expose their distinct sources of information and a real manuscript comparison?
decision_note.smallest_work: Content contracts, hand reconstruction of the two alternative inheritance readings, complete already-admitted f83r transcription intake and manual comparison with existing scene map. No model fitting, semantic scoreboard or toy decoder project.
decision_note.outcome_changes: A model lacking a declared source of its arguments/content is not selected for lexical fitting. Keep a specific common-page authoring problem where reference consequences can be compared; do not claim picture compatibility is evidence.
decision_note.budget: Final source intake, comparison, provenance validation and publication bounded15:08–15:30UTC. Earlier exploration is disclosed; no preregistered native test claimed.
